strengths: All seven verbatim lines (V1–V7) survive exactly, including the defiant pivot and the closing ad.
The Whittington identification still rests only on Tommy's hedged 'Clean shaven, I think' description, and the second man stays unnoticed.
The 'one young man is much like another' jab and Tommy's later 'second time' rejoinder remain a working setup and payoff.
The closed-office scene keeps the clerk's report: closed since yesterday afternoon, being wound up, office to let, no address known.
summary: The revision keeps every essential beat and all seven verbatim lines. It also keeps the two-fiver arithmetic and the clerk's report on the Esthonia Glassware office. One cut needs repair: removing the 'poor father' clause leaves Tommy's 'Perhaps that's so... But you didn't invent it' contradicting itself. Other revision-stage cuts thin the premise for the sleuthing plan, the money reveal and the move to lunch, and some distinctive comic tags. The ad-writing compression comes from the first draft and is a defensible tradeoff.
